title: Bells-and-Whistles Features
summary: Reviews in this topic focus on enthusiasm for the vehicle's many features and tech, while some comments only note the abundance of features without a clear positive or negative judgment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the car's plentiful tech, included features, and appealing bells-and-whistles experience.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention many features or bells and whistles, but the sentiment is unclear and one example suggests the feature set may be hard to sort out.

limitations: The sample is small and sentiment is unclear in several fragments, limiting how specifically the feature experience can be characterized.
One positive fragment appears to emphasize the sales team's walkthrough of features as much as the features themselves, so the topic is not perfectly uniform.
